claims.text: Employees must submit their leave requests at least 3 working days before the requested leave date.
Full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
Employees may work remotely for up to 2 days per week with prior manager approval.
Employees are expected to maintain a minimum attendance rate of 90% per month.
A medical certificate is required after more than 2 consecutive working days of illness.
Unused annual leave may be carried forward to the following year subject to company approval.
Overtime must be approved by a manager before the additional work is performed.
Emergency leave may be submitted on the same day in unforeseen circumstances.
Leave requests must be submitted at least 7 working days in advance.
Full-time employees receive 30 days of paid annual leave each calendar year.
Employees may work remotely for up to 4 days per week with manager approval.
The minimum attendance rate required is 75% per month.
Overtime eligibility begins after 35 hours of work in a week.
Unused annual leave is forfeited at the end of the calendar year.
The company provides a fully subsidised health insurance plan for all employees.
Employees receive an annual performance bonus every December.
Parental leave is granted for a period of 12 weeks.
The company matches retirement savings contributions up to 5 percent of salary.
